description: E120. `reasons`: why an outcome declaration, a change or a read of states was refused, one closed key per check, one sentence each; nothing was stored. `checks`: why an acceptance record (ophiolite.outcome-check/1) is rejected for its validity or inputs, or not compared, one closed key each, with the words a person reads after "Rejected" or "Not checked".

reasons.schema: The declaration does not have the outcome's shape.
reasons.rule: There is no such built-in rule for this kind of result.
reasons.settings: The rule's settings are not the ones it takes.
reasons.inputs: The inputs are not the ones the rule reads.
reasons.label: The name of an outcome must read as words, for example "Tops within 5 m".
reasons.destination: The destination must name a send procedure and a label that reads as words, with no address or secret in it.
reasons.permission: Only a project administrator can declare or change outcomes.
reasons.withdrawn: This outcome was withdrawn; it can no longer be changed.
reasons.label-taken: Another outcome in this project already has this name.
reasons.unchanged: This version already says exactly this; nothing was changed.
reasons.not-found: There is no such outcome in this project.
reasons.request: This command id was used for another request.
reasons.result: You cannot read this result version, so it has no outcome states for you.
reasons.not-again: Publish for an outcome is for an output of a run made again; nothing was published.
reasons.kind: This outcome is not declared over this kind of result; nothing was published.
reasons.disabled: This outcome is disabled; nothing was published.
reasons.answered: This output was already answered; run again to publish for this outcome.

checks.rows_missing: rows missing: the result leaves out rows its selection requires
checks.rows_unexpected: rows unexpected: the result has rows its selection does not require
checks.rows_duplicated: rows duplicated: the result gives a row of its selection more than once
checks.rows_mismatched: rows mismatched: a row's top, trajectory or reason, or the result's settings, are not the run's
checks.unit_mismatch: units disagree: the outcome is in {outcome_unit}, the result in {result_unit}
checks.no_validity: the result has no record of whether its rows are the run's
checks.nothing_computed: no row of the result has a computed residual
